UnitStatement: core/product_preview/service.py provides schema-adjacent service functions for the invented desktop product preview; it stays local and deterministic and runs no external solvers or hidden model mutations.
PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY constant asserts human_review_required=True and that the software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, or approval claims.

PROHIBITED_TEXT lists guardrail phrases (e.g. 'code compliant','certified','sealed','professional approval','approved for construction','release ready','production ready') that must not appear in preview output.
load_preview_model() loads the invented preview model fixture invented_preview_model.json.
run_preview_mechanics() returns a deterministic mechanics/status envelope from an invented result fixture; it does not run external solver/prover execution or rule-pack checking.
run_preview_mechanics attaches PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY and sets accepted_model_state_mutated=False on its result.
build_analysis_run_preview() builds an immutable analysis-run record from the preview mechanics result, with preview model-state, solver-settings, and SI unit-system refs.
build_report_packet_preview() materializes read-only report-packet context; it is not a rendered calculation report, export adapter payload, compliance result, or professional acceptance record.

The preview report packet records professional_boundary, a privacy_boundary (invented_public_example, no private/protected payload, telemetry disallowed), and report_packet_status flags marking it read-only context only.
build_agent_proposal_preview() returns a deterministic non-mutating proposal preview with application_status='not_applied' and accepted_model_state_mutated=False.
build_model_tree() builds tree/inspector input records for the desktop UI from nodes, pipe_segments, supports, and components.
validate_preview_model() validates the bounded product-preview shape and guardrail text, returning structured diagnostics.

Preview validation emits blocking diagnostics PREVIEW_DOCUMENT_KIND_INVALID, PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION_MISSING, and PREVIEW_GEOMETRY_INCOMPLETE when document_kind, schema_version, or geometry (nodes/pipe_segments) are missing.
Combination validation requires basis=='mechanics' and non-empty terms, and emits blocking diagnostics for unsupported basis, empty terms, unknown referenced load_case, and non-finite factor.
Pipe-segment validation flags PREVIEW_PIPE_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN when from/to nodes are unknown and PREVIEW_UNIT_METADATA_MISSING when outside_diameter or wall_thickness lack value/unit metadata.
Support validation emits PREVIEW_SUPPORT_NODE_UNKNOWN when a support's node is not a known node id.
Preview validation serializes the record to canonical JSON and emits PREVIEW_PROHIBITED_CLAIM_TEXT for any PROHIBITED_TEXT phrase found.
canonical_json() returns deterministic JSON via json.dumps with sort_keys=True, compact separators, and ensure_ascii=True.
hash_ref() returns a sha256 hash record over canonical JSON of a payload with algorithm 'sha256' and canonicalization 'JCS'.
_validate_identity_and_provenance() requires a non-empty id and a provenance containing 'invented' or 'cleared', else emits PREVIEW_ID_MISSING or PREVIEW_PROVENANCE_MISSING.
core/project_persistence/__init__.py exposes project persistence service helpers for TP-PER-01.

project_persistence package re-exports its public API including build/validate/round_trip persistence envelope, create/open/save/migrate/version_check project store, hash manifest, and retrieval sidecar helpers.

core/project_persistence/service.py builds deterministic project persistence envelopes and implements the SCA-003 MVP local SQLite store/index profile, where canonical JSON/JCS payload bytes remain the domain truth.
Persistence service constants define DOCUMENT_KIND 'openpipestress.project_persistence', schema refs, SQLITE_STORE_PROFILE 'sqlite_local_project_store', and SQLITE_STORE_SCHEMA_VERSION '1'.
Persistence PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY requires human_review_required=True and denies compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims.
PRIVATE_DATA_MARKER classifies persisted payloads as public_permissive with default_transmission_allowed=False and quarantine_required=False.
ENGINE_PROVENANCE records source name/location, project-governed license, contributor certification 'implementation-only-no-professional-claim', and public_permissive redistribution.

physical_container_profile() returns the accepted SCA-003 container: SQLite local store/index projection where SQL is not a public contract, direct SQL access and hosted DB are disallowed, no network is required, and sidecars are rebuildable.
retrieval_sidecar_manifest() returns a default non-authoritative, rebuildable, hash-neutral local sqlite_fts5_bm25 retrieval sidecar that can be deleted and rebuilt from canonical payloads.
build_project_persistence_envelope() builds a deterministic persistence envelope around a canonical model, assembling project, migration, validation_profile, service_operations, and a content hash.

The persistence envelope's round_trip_manifest declares canonical_json_jcs serialization, lists semantically-equal fields, empty volatile_fields, and normalization rules (schema_approved_only, no_silent_engineering_defaults, documented_volatile_field_exclusion).
The validation_profile enables schema, unit-metadata, provenance, rule-pack-reference, protected-content, private-data, and professional-boundary checks with telemetry_default 'off'.
validate_project_persistence_envelope() returns structured diagnostics for TP-PER-01 persistence invariants.
Persistence validation emits PERSISTENCE_FIELD_MISSING for missing schema_version, document_kind, project, hash, or migration, and PERSISTENCE_DOCUMENT_KIND_INVALID for a wrong document_kind.

Persistence validation emits PERSISTENCE_PRIVATE_DATA_BOUNDARY_INVALID, PERSISTENCE_PROVENANCE_MISSING, and PERSISTENCE_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION when private-data, provenance, or professional-boundary invariants fail.
Persistence validation emits PERSISTENCE_TELEMETRY_DEFAULT_INVALID when validation_profile.telemetry_default is not 'off'.
Persistence validation recomputes the expected hash and emits PERSISTENCE_PROJECT_HASH_MISMATCH and PERSISTENCE_HASH_MANIFEST_MISMATCH on mismatch.
create_project_store() creates a local SQLite project store and saves the canonical envelope via save_project_store.

open_project_store() opens a local SQLite store, returns its canonical envelope, validates it, and emits PERSISTENCE_STORE_MISSING / PERSISTENCE_STORE_PAYLOAD_MISSING / PERSISTENCE_STORE_HASH_MISMATCH diagnostics.
save_project_store() saves canonical envelope bytes into a local SQLite store, recomputing physical_container, sidecars, and hash, and aborts if any diagnostic is blocking.
version_check_project_store() returns separate db_migration_status and product_schema_migration_status, marking product schema 'current' only when schema_version matches.
migrate_project_store() classifies migration state and performs no silent product migration, emitting PERSISTENCE_PRODUCT_SCHEMA_MIGRATION_REQUIRED when needed.
rebuild_retrieval_sidecars() rebuilds local retrieval indexes without changing canonical project hashes and reports hash_neutral by comparing before/after project payload hash.
external_artifact_reference() builds a schema-shaped external artifact reference with sha256 NONE-canonicalization hash and copy_policy 'reference_in_place_by_default'.
validate_external_artifact_references() validates external artifacts without leaking paths, emitting MISSING, STALE, HASH_MISMATCH, and PRIVATE diagnostics; remote URIs are skipped.
round_trip_project_envelope() serializes and parses an envelope through canonical JSON and reports semantic_equal plus source/round-trip hashes.
_hash_metadata() builds deterministic JCS hash records: a project_payload_hash, a hash_manifest, and excludes retrieval_sidecars from the hash.

_valid_physical_container() accepts a container only when status='accepted', profile is SQLITE_STORE_PROFILE, decision_ref 'SCA-003', SQL not a public contract, no direct SQL/hosted DB/network, and sidecars rebuildable.

_valid_provenance() requires source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_status, and rejects protected_suspected redistribution.
_service_operations() declares application-service operations (create/open/save/validate/version_check/migrate) with minimum inputs/outputs, a fixed diagnostic-class set, and bypass_prohibited=True.
Crate open_pipe_stress_audit_manifest (v0.1.0, edition 2021, publish=false) provides audit manifest and model hash support for OpenPipeStress.

The audit_manifest crate is the bounded implementation slice for DEL-08-02: it records reproducibility metadata for model/run evidence without storing private project payloads or claiming professional approval.

Audit manifest scope: project-local deterministic JSON serialization with sorted keys for hash input, and SHA-256 hashes for model payloads, manifest entries, rule-pack checksum references, binary assets, and external artifacts.

Audit manifest scope records a solver version stamp, unit-system reference, payload references, asset manifest entries, and rule-pack audit references, plus deterministic findings for missing hashes, provenance, mismatches, duplicates, private/redacted boundaries, protected-content risk, and professional-boundary violations.

Audit manifest boundary: the crate does not parse project files, choose a physical container, validate full JCS canonicalization, store private rule-pack payloads, import protected standards content, authenticate engineering work, or emit professional/code-compliance claims; callers own persistence, storage, rendering, transport, and result-envelope integration.

Audit manifest verification: unit tests cover key-order stability, explicit non-JCS canonicalization metadata, hash change on material input change, binary/external asset hash recording, rule-pack checksum capture and slot validation, missing-manifest findings, duplicate references, private payload redaction, and absence of professional/code-compliance statuses.

audit_manifest/src/lib.rs creates deterministic audit metadata for model/run evidence; it hashes project-local deterministic JSON and caller asset bytes but does not parse project files, validate full JCS, store private payloads, import protected standards, or emit professional/code-compliance claims.

Callers needing RFC 8785 number rendering should route number strings through the shared renderer at core/serialization/canonical_json (completion-plan hardening row H5) before supplying them to CanonicalJson.
Notes: References hardening row H5 / shared renderer not defined in this slice.

UnitStatement: CanonicalJson enum models a project-local deterministic JSON value (Null, Bool, Number(String), String, Array, Object) whose object keys are ordered by BTreeMap; number strings are caller-supplied and not normalized under RFC 8785/JCS.
CanonicalJson.canonical_string() serializes values deterministically, joining array elements and 'key:value' object entries with commas and quoting strings via quote_json_string.
HashAlgorithm enum defines Sha256; Canonicalization enum defines ProjectLocalDeterministicJson and None.
PayloadKind enum enumerates ModelJson, InputManifestJson, RulePackReference, BinaryAsset, and ExternalArtifact.
PrivacyClass enum enumerates PublicMetadata, PrivateProjectData, PrivateRulePackData, Redacted, and Tbd.
RedistributionStatus enum enumerates PublicPermissive, PrivateOnly, Unknown, ProtectedSuspected, InventedNonEngineeringExample, and Tbd.
HashRecord struct holds algorithm, canonicalization, payload_kind, payload_ref, and value; constructors sha256_project_local_json and sha256_none set canonicalization accordingly.
HashRecord.is_empty() treats a blank value or a case-insensitive 'TBD' value as empty.
SolverVersionStamp records solver_name, solver_version, and solver_build_ref for reproducibility.
RulePackAuditRef records rule_pack_id, version, source_notice, redistribution_status, optional checksum HashRecord, and private_payload_redacted flag.
AssetManifestEntry records asset_id, payload_kind, privacy_class, optional hash, and provenance.
ProfessionalBoundary struct's project_default() sets human_review_required=true and all compliance/certification/sealing/approval claim flags to false.

ManifestFindingCode enumerates audit findings: missing model/input-manifest hash, missing solver version/build, missing unit-system, missing rule-pack checksum/source-notice, missing asset hash/provenance, private payload not redacted, protected-content suspected, duplicate reference, payload-kind/canonicalization mismatch, and professional-boundary violation.
ManifestFindingSeverity enumerates Info, Warning, and Blocking.
AuditManifest struct holds manifest_id, optional model_hash and input_manifest_hash, solver_version, unit_system_ref, rule_pack_refs, assets, and professional_boundary.
ManifestValidationResult.has_blocking_findings() returns true when any finding has Blocking severity.
hash_canonical_json() records a ProjectLocalDeterministicJson SHA-256 hash of a CanonicalJson value and is explicitly not a JCS conformance claim.
hash_asset() and hash_external_artifact() record SHA-256 hashes with Canonicalization::None for BinaryAsset and ExternalArtifact payloads.
validate_manifest() emits blocking MissingModelHash / MissingInputManifestHash when those hashes are absent or empty, otherwise checking the hash record.
validate_manifest emits blocking MissingSolverVersion when solver name or version is blank, and warning MissingSolverBuildRef when the build ref is blank or 'TBD'.
validate_manifest emits blocking MissingUnitSystem when unit_system_ref is blank, then runs duplicate-ref, rule-pack, asset, and professional-boundary checks.
check_duplicate_refs() tracks model_hash, input_manifest_hash, rule-pack, checksum, and asset payload refs and emits a DuplicateReference warning when a reference is reused.
check_rule_pack_refs() requires a non-empty rule-pack checksum (else blocking MissingRulePackChecksum) and warns MissingRulePackSourceNotice when the source notice is blank.

check_rule_pack_refs emits blocking ProtectedContentSuspected for ProtectedSuspected redistribution and blocking PrivatePayloadNotRedacted for PrivateOnly/Unknown/Tbd rule packs that are not redacted.
check_assets() requires a non-empty asset hash (else blocking MissingAssetHash) with canonicalization matching payload kind, warns MissingAssetProvenance when provenance is blank.
check_assets warns PrivatePayloadNotRedacted for private/redacted asset privacy classes and ProtectedContentSuspected for Tbd privacy class.
check_hash_record() emits blocking PayloadKindMismatch and PayloadCanonicalizationMismatch when a hash record's payload_kind or canonicalization does not match the manifest slot.
check_professional_boundary() emits blocking ProfessionalBoundaryViolation when any compliance/certification/sealing/approval claim is set or human_review_required is false.
quote_json_string() escapes JSON control characters and quotes/backslashes and emits \u00XX escapes for characters below U+001F.
The crate includes a dependency-free SHA-256 implementation (sha256/sha256_hex) used to hash payload and asset bytes.
Crate open_pipe_stress_protected_content_linter (v0.1.0, edition 2021, publish=false) provides report protected-content lint support for OpenPipeStress.

protected_content_linter/src/lib.rs evaluates caller-supplied public report/template/example text against deterministic synthetic markers and professional-boundary phrases; it does not read arbitrary files, scan private paths by default, quarantine, redact, run workflows, set CI/release policy, or provide legal/security/professional/code-compliance clearance.

SurfaceKind enum distinguishes public surfaces (PublicReportTemplate, PublicReportExample, PublicFixture) from private (PrivateUserTemplate, PrivateProjectExport); only public surfaces are scanned by default.

FindingCode enumerates ProtectedContentSyntheticMarker, PrivateDataSyntheticMarker, ProprietarySourceSyntheticMarker, UnknownProvenanceReviewRequired, ProhibitedProfessionalClaim, and SafeMetadataAllowed.
FindingClass enumerates IpBoundaryWarning, PrivateDataWarning, ProvenanceWarning, ProfessionalBoundaryWarning, and SafeMetadata.
ReviewRoute enumerates HumanIpReview, HumanPrivacyReview, HumanProfessionalBoundaryReview, MaintainerProvenanceReview, and NoAction.
ReviewStatus enumerates Pending, Accepted, Rejected, Quarantined, and NotApplicable.
Linter PrivacyClassification enumerates PublicMetadata, InventedPublicExample, PrivateProjectData, PrivateRulePackData, PrivateLibraryData, ProtectedSuspected, and Redacted.
Reference struct holds ref_type and ref_id and is_complete() when both are non-empty.

Provenance struct records source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, review_status, and privacy_classification; is_complete() requires the text fields non-empty.
LintTarget holds target_id, path, surface, text, and provenance, and is_complete() requires non-empty id/path and complete provenance.
SourceLocation records path, line, and column for a lint finding.
LintFinding records finding_id, code, class, severity, target_ref, source_location, matched_policy, excerpt, message, remediation, review_route, disposition, and provenance.
LintConfiguration::public_surfaces_only() defaults public_surface_roots to schemas/, fixtures/, and docs/ with scan_private_surfaces=false.
LintSummary records target/scanned/skipped-private/finding/blocking counts and clean_scan_is_clearance (always false).
lint_targets() scans eligible targets, sorts findings by ordering key, assigns deterministic finding ids RPLC-Fnnnn, and counts blocking findings; clean_scan_is_clearance is set false.
should_scan_target() scans only complete targets whose surface is public-by-default, unless scan_private_surfaces is enabled.
lint_target() scans each text line for synthetic markers and case-insensitive prohibited claim phrases, emitting findings with line/column.
lint_target emits a warning UnknownProvenanceReviewRequired finding when redistribution_status is Unknown or review_status is Pending.

synthetic_markers() defines blocking markers OPS_SYNTHETIC_PROTECTED_TABLE and OPS_SYNTHETIC_CODE_FORMULA (IP boundary), blocking OPS_SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_RULE_PAYLOAD (private data), and warning OPS_SYNTHETIC_VENDOR_CATALOG (proprietary source).

prohibited_claim_phrases() lists blocking professional-authority phrases: 'code compliant','certified by openpipestress','sealed by openpipestress','approved by openpipestress','authenticated by openpipestress','professional approval by the software'.
invented_provenance() returns an invented synthetic linter fixture provenance with InventedNonEngineeringExample redistribution and Accepted review status, certifying no protected source was copied.
Linter test asserts synthetic markers emit blocking findings in stable order with deterministic finding ids (RPLC-F0001 first).
Linter test asserts private surfaces are skipped by default (scanned_target_count=0) and clean_scan_is_clearance remains false.
Linter test asserts safe metadata text produces zero findings while clean_scan_is_clearance stays false.
Linter test asserts a 'code compliant' claim produces one blocking ProhibitedProfessionalClaim routed to HumanProfessionalBoundaryReview.
Crate open_pipe_stress_report_generator (v0.1.0, edition 2021, publish=false) provides calculation report assembly support; it has an optional serde dependency gated by a 'serde' feature.

report_generator/src/lib.rs validates bounded in-memory calculation report records, checks template slots, and prepares deterministic section ordering; it does not parse project files, call solver internals, render GUI, run workflows, lint protected content, redact, access host resources, or emit professional/code-compliance claims.

REQUIRED_SECTION_KINDS lists the eight governed report section kinds: ModelInputSummary, LoadCases, Results, WarningsAssumptionsProvenance, AuditManifest, RulePackReferences, Limitations, and ProfessionalBoundaryNotice.
AnalysisStatus enum enumerates ModelIncomplete, MechanicsSolved, RuleInputsIncomplete, UserRuleChecked, UserRuleFailed, and HumanReviewRequired.
DiagnosticClass enum enumerates SolveBlocking, RuleCheckBlocking, ProvenanceWarning, AssumptionWarning, NonlinearWarning, IpBoundaryWarning, UnitWarning, ReportBlocking, and TemplateBlocking.
SectionKind enum enumerates the eight governed report section kinds.
Report-generator RedistributionStatus enum enumerates PublicPermissive, PrivateOnly, Unknown, ProtectedSuspected, InventedNonEngineeringExample, and Tbd (serialized as 'TBD').

Provenance struct records source/license/contributor/certification, redistribution_status, review_status (String), and privacy_classification; is_complete() requires those text fields including review_status non-empty.
Provenance.has_boundary_gap() is true for Unknown/ProtectedSuspected/Tbd redistribution, private/protected privacy classifications, or TBD/pending review status.
ChecksumRef records algorithm, canonicalization, payload_ref, and value; is_complete() requires all present and value non-empty and not 'TBD'.

ReferencedEnvelope holds reference, schema_ref, checksum, privacy_classification, and provenance; is_complete() requires all complete, has_boundary_gap() detects private/protected classifications or provenance gaps.
UnitDisplaySummary records storage_convention, model_units, result_units, quantity_display_policy, and conversion_performed flag.
ModelInputSummary holds project/model/persistence/unit-system refs, optional unit_display_summary, model_hash, input_manifest_ref, and provenance; is_complete() requires all complete.
LoadCaseSummary records load_ref, label, basis, source, and provenance; is_complete() requires the refs complete and label/basis non-empty.

RulePackRef records rule_pack_id, version, checksum, source_notice, redistribution_status, completeness_status, and private_payload_redacted; is_safe_reference() requires all complete with payload redacted.
RulePackRef.has_boundary_gap() is true for Unknown/ProtectedSuspected/Tbd redistribution or TBD/incomplete completeness_status.
Report-generator ProfessionalBoundary adds software_makes_authentication_claim; preserves_boundary() requires human_review_required and all claim flags false.
Diagnostic struct records code, class, severity, source, affected_object, message, remediation, and provenance, with report_blocking/template_blocking/boundary_warning constructors.
TemplateSlot records slot_id, required flag, section_kind, source_contract, and ordering_index; is_complete() requires non-empty slot_id and complete source_contract.

RenderedSection records section_id, slot_id, section_kind, title, source_refs, and content_status; is_complete() requires non-empty fields, content_status not 'TBD', and non-empty complete source_refs.
UnresolvedTbd records tbd_id, topic, affected_scope, description, and review_needed; requires_review() requires non-empty fields and review_needed true.

CalculationReport aggregates report_id, model input summary, load cases, result-export/audit-manifest/report-section envelope refs, rule-pack refs, diagnostics, template slots, rendered sections, analysis status, professional boundary, provenance, privacy classification, and unresolved runtime TBDs.
ReportValidation.is_blocked() is true when any diagnostic has Blocking severity.
NeutralReportSection records ordering_index, section_id, title, source_count, and content_status for neutral test output.

validate_report() emits REPORT-MISSING-ID, REPORT-MODEL-SUMMARY-INCOMPLETE, and REPORT-LOADS-INCOMPLETE blocking diagnostics when report id, model summary, or load-case summaries are missing/incomplete.

validate_report requires non-empty complete result-export, audit-manifest, and report-section envelope references via check_referenced_envelopes (codes REPORT-MISSING-RESULT-EXPORT / -AUDIT-MANIFEST / -SECTIONS).
validate_report emits REPORT-RULE-PACK-REF-UNSAFE when any rule-pack reference is not safe, and warning REPORT-RULE-PACK-BOUNDARY-REVIEW for rule packs with boundary gaps.
validate_report emits REPORT-DIAGNOSTIC-INCOMPLETE when incoming diagnostics lack required fields, and REPORT-HUMAN-REVIEW-MISSING when analysis_status omits HumanReviewRequired.

validate_report emits REPORT-PROFESSIONAL-BOUNDARY when the boundary is not preserved, REPORT-PROVENANCE-INCOMPLETE for incomplete provenance, and REPORT-TBD-REVIEW-MISSING for non-review-needed runtime TBDs.
ordered_sections() maps rendered sections to template-slot ordering indexes and returns NeutralReportSection records sorted by ordering_index then section_id.
check_referenced_envelopes() emits a report-blocking diagnostic when an envelope-ref list is empty or any reference is incomplete.
check_reference_boundary_gaps() emits warning REPORT-REFERENCE-BOUNDARY-REVIEW for any referenced result-export/audit-manifest/report-section input with a boundary gap.

validate_template_slots() enforces complete unique slot ids and unique ordering indexes, requiring every governed section kind to be declared (REPORT-TEMPLATE-KIND-UNDECLARED) and rendered (REPORT-SECTION-KIND-UNRENDERED).

validate_template_slots emits REPORT-TEMPLATE-SLOT-UNFILLED for required slots without a rendered section, REPORT-SECTION-INCOMPLETE for incomplete sections, and REPORT-SECTION-UNKNOWN-SLOT for sections referencing unknown slots.

report_generator invented_provenance() returns the report-generator validator provenance with project_internal license, InventedNonEngineeringExample redistribution, accepted review, and PublicMetadata classification.
report_generator test validates that a complete report produces no blocking diagnostics.
report_generator test asserts ordered_sections orders sections by template slot index (indices 0..8).

report_generator tests assert blocking diagnostics for missing human-review status, professional-boundary violations, missing template sections, undeclared governed section kinds, and duplicate template ordering indexes.
report_generator tests assert REPORT-DIAGNOSTIC-INCOMPLETE for incomplete incoming diagnostics and non-blocking boundary-review warnings for referenced envelopes and rule packs with gaps.
Crate open_pipe_stress_report_renderer (v0.1.0, edition 2021, publish=false) is a deterministic hash-bound single-file HTML calculation-report renderer for OpenPipeStress (DEC-021).
report_renderer depends on report_generator (serde), report_sections (serde), protected_content_linter, serde, and sha2, with serde_json as a dev-dependency.
